meta.description: Deep research on GitHub tools, Claude skills and MCP servers for After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, motion design, VFX, SFX and 2D→3D work, with licenses checked.
meta.lede_html: Open-source tools, Claude skills and MCP servers that add 2D→3D, motion design, VFX and SFX power to an After Effects or DaVinci Resolve workflow. Every entry was checked against its GitHub page or official docs, and every license was read with monetized channels in mind.
meta.footer_html:
Research date: 29 September 2026. Star counts and dates are approximate and change quickly. Entries marked “Not verified at source” come from press or search results only.

License labels are a guide, not legal advice. A monetized YouTube, TikTok or Instagram channel counts as commercial use. The license of the model you run applies even when the app around it is MIT or GPL.

categories.label: Claude skills
categories.blurb: Agent Skills (SKILL.md folders) you install into Claude Code so it knows how to do a job.

categories.label: MCP servers
categories.blurb: Connectors that let Claude drive an app: Blender, Resolve, After Effects, Premiere, ComfyUI, FFmpeg.

categories.label: After Effects
categories.blurb: Free scripts, extensions, developer tools and 3D workflows for After Effects.

categories.label: Resolve & Fusion
categories.blurb: Free Fuses, macros, DCTLs, scripting tools and 3D workflows for DaVinci Resolve and Fusion.

categories.label: Depth maps
categories.blurb: Models that turn an image or clip into a depth map, the base of most 2D→3D effects.

categories.label: Parallax & 3D photo
categories.blurb: Turn one photo or frame into a moving 3D parallax shot.

categories.label: AI camera moves
categories.blurb: AI models that re-shoot a clip or a still with a new camera path: orbit, dolly, crane.

categories.label: Image → 3D models
categories.blurb: Make a textured 3D model (GLB) from one image, then use it in Blender or AE's 3D.

categories.label: 3D scenes & splats
categories.blurb: Rebuild a real place in 3D from video (Gaussian splats) and fly a new camera through it.

categories.label: Camera tracking
categories.blurb: Solve the camera of real footage so 3D text and objects stick to it.

categories.label: Motion capture
categories.blurb: Copy a person's movement from a normal video onto a 3D character.

categories.label: Stereo 3D & VR
categories.blurb: Convert a finished edit to side-by-side 3D, VR180 or Vision Pro spatial video.

categories.label: Roto & cleanup
categories.blurb: Masks, mattes, green-screen keys and object removal.

categories.label: Slow-mo & upscale
categories.blurb: Frame interpolation for smooth slow motion, and AI upscaling.

categories.label: VFX & simulation
categories.blurb: Relighting, element generation, particles, fire and smoke.

categories.label: SFX & beat sync
categories.blurb: AI sound effects synced to picture, beat detection and stem separation.

categories.label: Open-source apps
categories.blurb: Free editors and motion-graphics apps you can script.
